raw.body:
## What's Changed
* test(sortfmt): remove external parity test by @ThomasRooney in https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/pull/242
* ci(deps): bump jdx/mise-action from 4.2.3 to 4.2.5 in the github-actions group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/pull/237
* fix(yml): keep folded block scalars stable across encode round trips by @AshGodfrey in https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/pull/244
* fix(deps): bump the go-minor-patch group across 2 directories with 6 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/pull/239
* fix(deps): bump jsonschema/oas3/tests/testsuite from `be54236` to `6648e81` by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/pull/238
* chore: update submodule dependencies to latest main by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/pull/241

## New Contributors
* @AshGodfrey made their first contribution in https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/pull/244

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/speakeasy-api/openapi/compare/v1.25.0...v1.25.1

## OpenAPI CLI v1.25.1

This release includes binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows on both x86_64 and ARM64 architectures.

### Installation

Download the appropriate binary for your platform from the assets below, extract it, and add it to your PATH.

### Changes

## Changelog
### Bug fixes
* 9925d69ccf10721c1e84079012c35b509409a30e fix(deps): bump jsonschema/oas3/tests/testsuite from `be54236` to `6648e81` (#238)
* ea2d24d30d873cd596fb224db46c23e9fff0e66c fix(deps): bump the go-minor-patch group across 2 directories with 6 updates (#239)
* a1a2ace46e3d665b9d49eee6e0428b661eb67054 fix(yml): keep folded block scalars stable across encode round trips (#244)
### Others
* a9b7ba1801fcc732d4668934e8deb90045588953 ci(deps): bump jdx/mise-action from 4.2.3 to 4.2.4 in the github-actions group (#237)
* 356660f0271d6fca66dbf70edc70fb4c72dd5ae1 test(sortfmt): remove external parity test (#242)
